correction.explicit_env: DEV_IMAGE=vibeflow-dev:latest on Trivy scan and dev-image SBOM steps

failing_steps: Build dev container and run runtime smoke inside the exact image

fix_1_devcontainers_ci_imagename_defect.root_cause: devcontainers/ci defaults imageTag to 'latest' and buildImageNames joins `${imageName}:${tag}`, so imageName 'vibeflow-dev:smoke' became invalid 'vibeflow-dev:smoke:latest' (invalid reference format). Verified from pinned source 513af61f4de4f75d37e4438f184ba4358f0fc1ca github-action/dist/index.js.

fix_2_active_non_root_validator.requirement: active M-007 requires BOTH remoteUser == 'node' AND containerUser == 'node' (missing or wrong value fails); durable may change the user only with an owning later-mission declaration; root permanently banned

fix_3_durable_extension_ownership.requirement: extension entries authorize changes only when owned (mission_id) by the actually active later mission; active M-007 snapshot requires zero durable extensions; permanent bans (privileged, docker socket, host network, raw secrets, silent privilege expansion) remain regardless of declarations

blocker_1_bootstrap_no_tty_purge.failure: ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY during postCreateCommand pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: host checkout node_modules visible through the workspace bind mount with host pnpm-store symlinks; pnpm attempted to purge/recreate modules dir non-interactively.
blocker_1_bootstrap_no_tty_purge.fix: canonical container-local volume: source=vibeflow-node-modules,target=${containerWorkspaceFolder}/node_modules,type=volume (shadows host node_modules; host files untouched; frozen-lockfile bootstrap unchanged; no TTY required; no CI-only path).
blocker_1_bootstrap_no_tty_purge.validator: active M-007 requires exactly the node_modules volume (removal or any extra mount fails).

blocker_2_wrappers_not_executable.failure: scripts/security/scan-dev-image.sh and generate-dev-image-sbom.sh tracked 100644; CI exit 126 Permission denied.
blocker_2_wrappers_not_executable.fix: both chmod 100755; validator enforces os.access X_OK on fresh checkout.

blocker_3_durable_feature_extensions.fix: active: exactly python feature + zero extensions; durable: retain python, allow additional features only when registered in the policy/provenance structure, digest-pinned, options exact, and owned by the active later mission or an already-completed later mission (historical remain); unrelated/future missions authorize nothing.

blocker_4_durable_runargs.fix: any non-empty durable runArgs require an extension owned by the active later mission (exact value + rationale); permanent bans (--privileged, host network, --cap-add/--security-opt, docker-socket/host-credential/ssh-agent) enforced independently and never declarable.

blocker_5_durable_user_fields.fix: both remoteUser and containerUser must remain explicitly present and non-root in durable mode (missing/null/empty/root/UID-0 always fail); change from node requires exact owning-active-mission declaration; root ban never overridable.

test_counts.note: Round 3 grew M-007 from 53 to 78 tests (blockers 1-5 coverage).

validator_design.active_snapshot: exact accepted environment shape including BOTH remoteUser == 'node' and containerUser == 'node'; zero durable extensions allowed; provenance, toolchain, capability snapshot, mission/ledger sync, master hash integrity
validator_design.durable_policy: later owning missions declare growth via durable_extension_policy.extensions owned by the actually active later mission (mission_id + rationale + exact values); historical extensions from completed later missions remain; additional features must be registered, digest-pinned and owned; durable runArgs require an owning declaration; both user fields must remain explicit and non-root; privileged/docker-socket/host-network/raw-secrets permanently banned
validator_design.forward_compatible: positive durable-extension test included in the M-007 mutation suite
validator_design.mode_selection: auto: active while M-007 is READY/IN_PROGRESS/REVIEW; durable once M-007 is DONE
